title: peak-auto/1: the peaks of `mzlab-cli peak auto`
description: Every high-resolution peak of a trace found by the engine, with the area under the chosen baseline mode, and the automatic choices made on the way. Times in minutes, areas in counts x s (counts x min with --area-unit min). Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/peaks_auto_cmd.rs, crates/mzlab-core/src/peakq_auto.rs.

b0.description: Baseline at t0, counts. Absent under baseline zero (the area is measured from 0); with line it is the line at t0; with edges the detection baseline end.

b1.description: Baseline at t1, counts. Same rules as b0.

area.description: Area under the baseline mode, counts x s.

below.description: The part of the trace under the baseline, same unit as area. Absent with edges.

choices.description: Every automatic choice the command made, with its reason; empty when it made none.
